0022600122.text: The Miami Heat (0-3, losers of three straight) host the Dallas Mavericks (1-2, coming off a loss) in the Heat's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Miami 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back. Dallas, 12th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, is missing five players: Caleb Martin (thumb, sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder, sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, and their last meeting was a 118-108 Heat loss in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
